text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To prepare a countermeasure against 
Kitasan Black, Satono Crown honed her 
final spurt. How could she acquire an 
explosive closing burst like Duramente's?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, conversing with Duramente made 
her realize: There's no need to become 
someone else. Follow your own convictions 
and overcome adversity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That confidence sharpens Satono Crown's 
final kick. Fully prepared, she charges 
onward to the Kyoto Kinen—!
